content: Project-level skills discovered from .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/ directories (GSD convention per project-skills-discovery.md). Global user skills live in ~/.claude/skills/. agentskills.io spec shows skill directory name must match the SKILL.md name field. For a repo-level skill: .claude/skills/fdars-advisor/ is the recommended location, making it available to GSD agents without a separate global install.
